Added `specs/permission_state.md`: consolidates the diagnoses from the `preston/suspicious-hertz-299e5c` (+ `preston/permission-resolution-request-id`) and `preston/blissful-keller-cc6ec0` investigation branches into a single issue describing how the in-chat permission cards go stale or show the wrong verdict, plus the rework plan the same PR implements and then simplifies further: request-id verdict correlation via a machine-readable resolution tag, one resolutions message carrying both the live flip and a chrome-pushed load-time snapshot, persistent nudge retries, deletion of the arrival-order fallback, and -- going beyond the plan -- deletion of the mirrored request inbox (the gateway's own queue is read on demand) and of the legacy JSONL request channel.

Also resolved and removed the `uncertainties.md` entry this spec had filed about `latchkey-permissions.md` overstating the resolution round trip's reliability; the doc updates land in the same PR. The macOS `_scproxy` item in the spec's plan turned out to be already obsoleted by the warm-process `MngrCaller` redesign.
